Reference image for the [[Anagrams]] row on [[Debnoli]], whose title is an anagram of Blondie: Blondie (Clint Eastwood), the Man with No Name, in his poncho with a cigarillo at Sad Hill cemetery before the final standoff in ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly'' (1966).

Source: a frame at 1:13 of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WCnRSl24FPA The Good, The Bad and The Ugly | Official Sizzle | 4K], Arrow Video, YouTube (3 July 2025), from the 3840 by 2160 stream. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260807221951/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WCnRSl24FPA Internet Archive], 7 August 2026. Cropped to Eastwood and reduced to 700 by 869 pixels. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: ea132588fb106279b3d24c2677f800b3ae6c4a47d53bdff08d7cce97083d72b8.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a single cropped, reduced-size frame from a distributor's promotional video for ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly'', © Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer, used only to show the character the card title refers to, beside the card on [[Anagrams]], on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the film or harm its market, and no free image of the character exists.
